data.gender_notes: Jeremaya is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jeremaya is recorded in name-lists as “God will raise up”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jeremaya expresses “God will raise up”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeremaya total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
